editorial.last_message: Completed standalone MARC21 inspect/render for ISO2709 and MARCXML. Unchanged source scores 2841/2900 under corrected MARC21 3.0.2, up from 2832/2900; remaining failures concern fixed-control rules and omitted first-subfield definitions for five tags.
editorial.notes:
Completed voluntarily with a substantial standalone Python MARC21 inspector/renderer for ISO2709 and MARCXML. Full preserved transcript reviewed: source derives compressed profiles for 245 fields from supplied public HTML; actual probes cover Unicode in both formats, binary record lengths/terminators, malformed UTF-8, repeatability, indicators, namespace and surrogate handling, and CLI execution. Initial mistaken leader-length self-test was corrected before the final successful checks. No auth, quota or disconnect interruption. Original 3.0.1 grade was 2832/2900. Official 3.0.2 zero-inference regrade confirms 2841/2900: the valid 357 and 880 example repairs recover eight cases across four actions, and ordering the empty500 fixture by field group recovers one.
